title: Abandoned cart reminder
description: WhatsApp abandoned cart template that reminds shoppers about items left in their cart and links straight back to checkout.
notes: Send 1 to 3 hours after abandonment; later messages feel stale. Only message shoppers who opted in at checkout, and keep it free of fake urgency.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, you left *{{product_name}}* in your cart. It's still waiting for you, and we saved your spot so you can finish in one tap.
